        Production Python Code
        
The Core NLP Pipeline Behind the Algorithm

        
A look at the production code from Bibek's public GitHub repository Content---Semantic-Flow-Checker-.

      

    

    

      

        
        semantic_flow_checker.py · GitHub @bibek1223
      

      
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer, util
import spacy

# Load lightweight transformer model and spaCy parser
nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
model = SentenceTransformer("all-MiniLM-L6-v2")

def analyze_semantic_flow(query: str, headers: list[str]):
    query_emb = model.encode(query, convert_to_tensor=True)
    header_embs = model.encode(headers, convert_to_tensor=True)
    
    # Calculate cosine similarity matrix
    scores = util.cos_sim(query_emb, header_embs)[0]
    
    return [
        {"header": h, "similarity_score": round(float(score), 4)}
        for h, score in zip(headers, scores)
    ]

# Example Output
# Header 1: 0.8421 (High Salience · RAG Retained)
# Header 2: 0.7914 (High Salience · RAG Retained)
# Header 3: 0.1102 (Off-topic Drift · Pruned by LLM Retriever)
